original_frozen_record: PARTIAL_FAIL | GPU-C8 CONFIRMED; GPU-C5 expected HOLD -> actual ALLOW; C6/C7 scope limitations preserved
principle: R1 adds new files only. No original CUDA-EP-001 artifact is modified, overwritten, amended, or relabeled.

engine_changes.original_behavior: _control() returned PASS iff shutil.which('nvidia-smi') was truthy; HOLD only if nvidia-smi absent. On a real GPU host nvidia-smi is always present, so control-HOLD was not inducible without removing the GPU (BLOCKED_NO_GPU).
engine_changes.remediated_behavior: _control(contract) compares contract['control_state_token'] against policy['required_control_state'] ('LAUNCH_WINDOW_OPEN'). PASS iff equal; HOLD if different or absent. Independent of nvidia-smi presence, so HOLD is inducible while a real GPU is present.

engine_changes.original_behavior: _constraint() checked expiry + policy version, then DENY only if target_compute_capability was EMPTY. It never compared requested capability to the detected device capability (comment acknowledged 'would compare to detected device on GPU').
engine_changes.remediated_behavior: Detects the physical device compute capability (detect_device_compute_capability(): nvidia-smi --query-gpu=compute_cap, torch fallback) and compares it to the contract's target_compute_capability. DENY on absent, not-accepted, or (required != detected). PASS only when required == detected and accepted.

engine_changes.original_behavior: gateway.evaluate() had NO verification branch. ProofRecord mutation detection was performed only by an external Dilithium3 verifier (verify_gpu_proofrecords.py), never as a native gateway verdict. CUDA-EP-001 recorded this as a signature-layer result, not a gateway path.
engine_changes.remediated_behavior: New _verify_proofrecord(contract) engine inside evaluate(), executed AFTER control PASS and BEFORE capability release. Recomputes the canonical body and verifies the Dilithium3 signature with the embedded public key. On failure/missing, evaluate() returns a native VERIFICATION_FAILURE verdict and releases no capability.

preserved_properties: exclusive-launcher property: launch_or_block() invoked only on ALLOW (C8)
